recoveredFrom: No prior lesson file existed in git history, worktrees, or sibling repos. These records reimplement defect classes already enforced in scattered Brand Explorer validators, plus the failure classes required for a single mutation suite. Reported counts of 60–70 lessons had no recoverable registry and are not counted as active.

lessons.rootCause: Visible cards shipped with an empty body.
lessons.preventionRule: A visible disposition must carry owner-facing text.
lessons.remediationRule: Research the item or set an explicit disposition. Do not leave it blank.

lessons.rootCause: Title-only or one-line cards passed as complete.
lessons.preventionRule: Positive narrative items need enough words to answer the owner question.
lessons.remediationRule: Expand the answer or change the disposition. Do not pad with template prose.

lessons.rootCause: Brand-name substitution of another profile's prose.
lessons.preventionRule: Block known template markers and internal factory language.
lessons.remediationRule: Rewrite from brand evidence. Do not swap the brand name in a shared paragraph.

lessons.rootCause: Suppression was used instead of a researched answer.
lessons.preventionRule: DEPENDENT_SUPPRESSED_JUSTIFIED requires a visible parent conclusion.
lessons.remediationRule: Render the parent answer, then suppress only dependent detail.

lessons.rootCause: A meaningful negative such as residences or franchise was omitted.
lessons.preventionRule: Negative and known-zero dispositions must remain visible.
lessons.remediationRule: Show the negative answer. Do not drop the item.

lessons.rootCause: A collection was closed before it met EXACT or MINIMUM cardinality.
lessons.preventionRule: Compare rendered children to the collection contract.
lessons.remediationRule: Research additional members or record a contract-legal conditional absence.

lessons.rootCause: A named loyalty program rendered one generic card instead of every applicable tier.
lessons.preventionRule: When a conventional program exists, tiers use ALL_SOURCE_MEMBERS.
lessons.remediationRule: Enumerate the current tiers from the program source.

lessons.rootCause: Profiles invented region names outside the renderer taxonomy.
lessons.preventionRule: Region labels must be Americas, CALA, Europe, MEA, APAC.
lessons.remediationRule: Map presence into the five product regions. Do not rename the product taxonomy inside a brand.

lessons.rootCause: A grid was rendered with the wrong column count.
lessons.preventionRule: Geometry contract columns are product-owned.
lessons.remediationRule: Use the contract column count for that collection.

lessons.rootCause: A full-width collection rendered in a partial column.
lessons.preventionRule: Contract collections marked fullWidth must not set partialWidth.
lessons.remediationRule: Restore the full-width grid.

lessons.rootCause: One property card named more than one hotel.
lessons.preventionRule: One property card equals one property.
lessons.remediationRule: Split the card. Do not ship a collection-level representative-properties blob.

lessons.rootCause: An image was verified as a different property from the card.
lessons.preventionRule: VERIFIED_WRONG_PROPERTY cannot satisfy the card.
lessons.remediationRule: Replace the image with an exact-property source or use APPROVED_NO_IMAGE.

lessons.rootCause: A sibling hotel image was reused to fill a property card.
lessons.preventionRule: Same-brand donor images do not establish property identity.
lessons.remediationRule: Source an exact-property image or record APPROVED_NO_IMAGE.

lessons.rootCause: A metric rendered with no value and no evidence state.
lessons.preventionRule: Every metric has a value or an explicit evidence state.
lessons.remediationRule: Set KNOWN_VALUE, KNOWN_ZERO, NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED, OUT_OF_SCOPE, or RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

lessons.rootCause: A number shipped without unit, geography, or time scope.
lessons.preventionRule: KNOWN_VALUE metrics require unit and scope.
lessons.remediationRule: Add unit and scope. Do not leave a bare number.

lessons.rootCause: Missing data was stored as zero.
lessons.preventionRule: Zero is allowed only as KNOWN_ZERO with a scope.
lessons.remediationRule: Replace invented zeros with RESEARCH_REQUIRED or NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

lessons.rootCause: Two tabs stated different values for the same fact.
lessons.preventionRule: Each fact id has one canonical value.
lessons.remediationRule: Point every tab at the same fact node.

lessons.rootCause: Tab validation continued after a server restart or across mixed builds.
lessons.preventionRule: expected, activated, measurable, and audited must all equal 10 on one PID and one build signature.
lessons.remediationRule: Restart the live run on one stable server.

lessons.rootCause: A single subsystem pass was treated as founder-review readiness.
lessons.preventionRule: Only MASTER_RELEASE_CONTRACT_PASS may set READY_FOR_FOUNDER_REVIEW.
lessons.remediationRule: Clear subsystem readiness. Run the master contract.

lessons.rootCause: Flexibility bodies used words outside Minimal, Low, Moderate, Medium, High, Very high.
lessons.preventionRule: Flexibility bodies are one canonical level.
lessons.remediationRule: Sanitize to a canonical level. Put narrative in standards philosophy.

lessons.rootCause: Momentum cards shipped without a trailing announcement URL.
lessons.preventionRule: Each momentum child needs a date, a summary, and an https announcement URL.
lessons.remediationRule: Attach the announcement URL or drop the card if it does not qualify.

lessons.rootCause: Tab Factory audited 7 tabs while the renderer shipped 10.
lessons.preventionRule: TAB_CONTRACTS and the renderer must share the canonical 10 tab ids.
lessons.remediationRule: Import the product shell. Do not keep a second tab list.

lessons.rootCause: Task reports expected about 70 cumulative lessons. Git history, worktrees, ignored files, and sibling repositories contain no lesson registry.
lessons.preventionRule: Do not mark a lesson active without a validator and a mutation test.
lessons.remediationRule: Reimplement each historical defect only after the original rule is recovered.
